replace_with.description: The caveat a blocked passage gives way to, in a mutable output.

left_out.description: Notes the reader may see that this block's size left out: each is kept, and the note search reads it.

AgentMemoryExport.description: Every note of one source, every version, for portability of the agent's own work.

conversation_id.title: Conversation Id

source_id.description: The agent that owns the note.

supersedes_note_id.description: The version this one replaced; that one is `retired`.

valid_until.description: After this moment the note leaves the block and the search.

origin.description: `distilled` from a conversation or task; `agent` when the space holds agent writes for a person.
origin.title: Origin

problem.description: Why a distillation failed: `nothing_to_propose`, `personal_data`, `no_turns`, or `unconfirmed_link` (the conversation spoke only through a link a claim made and nobody confirmed yet; ask again once it is confirmed).

A write of an agent's working state, by its code and never by a model: `cas` replaces the whole state

subject.description: The customer the state is about, when its scope does not name them: erasing the customer and their data package find the state by it.

suppressed_groups.description: Groups below the minimum size, withheld.

target.description: `fact`, `open_item`, `signal`, `trait` or `contradiction`; `signal:used`, `signal:repeated`, `signal:contradicted` or `signal:selection_miss` for each signal of the measurement; `contradiction:model` and `contradiction:band` for the pairs each origin found; `all`.

coverage.description: Counted apart: law and fact never add up.

ApproveProposalRequest.description: A person may edit the proposal before approving it; the edit passes the redactor again.
ApproveProposalRequest.title: ApproveProposalRequest

ArmComparison.description:
One arm against `control` on one metric, adjusted by CUPED when the history varies, with the mixture
sequential test: its p-value and interval hold at any look, so the report may be read every day.

ci_low.description: The always-valid interval of `difference` at the test's `alpha`.
ci_low.title: Ci Low

decided.description: `p_value` at or below `alpha`: the difference is real.
decided.title: Decided

difference.description: The arm minus the control, per person, adjusted.
difference.title: Difference

looks.description: The daily looks kept before this one.
looks.title: Looks

p_value.description: The running minimum over the daily looks and this one.
p_value.title: P Value

variance_reduction.description: The share of the variance CUPED removed; absent when it did not apply.
variance_reduction.title: Variance Reduction

ArmComparison.title: ArmComparison

ArmOutcomes.description: The people one arm holds and what they did after they were assigned, from the outcome links.

converted.description: People with an outcome in a success state.

value_minor.description: Their lines' money, each line once whatever the method.
value_minor.title: Value Minor

ArmOutcomes.title: ArmOutcomes

One assertion over the run's completed executions, against its baseline. `p_value` is the one-sided

drop.description: The baseline's pass rate minus the run's.
drop.title: Drop

AssertionStats.title: AssertionStats

description.description: What the agent is for, or the rule in plain words; masked before any use.

example_payload.description: An example event of the system, as it will arrive, for a mapping before any event came: masked on arrival (keys and codes kept, values replaced) and only the masked copy is kept or used.

checks.description: Validation against the samples, inside the cell.

diff_id.description: The diff waiting for approval in the control plane.
diff_id.title: Diff Id

document.description: The proposed configuration document, as sent to the control plane.
document.title: Document

Attribute.description:
What the person is: a size, a preferred network, a diet. Said here; the lifecycle's outcomes (bought,
kept, returned for size) derive the rest on the server, never an agent.
Attribute.title: Attribute

AttributionReport.description:
Value by day, agent, method and band, deterministic and probable apart; a value is never multiplied by
a confidence, and no total adds a probable value to a deterministic one.
AttributionReport.title: AttributionReport

AttributionTotal.description: One method, band and finality over the period: deterministic and probable are never added together.
AttributionTotal.title: AttributionTotal

Backing.description:
What the SDK's backing check found in an agent's turn: every number, date, code and
amount the turn states, looked up in the pack, the system records, the customer's own words and the
tool results the agent recorded. Kinds and counts, never a value.

checked.description: Values the check read in the turn.
checked.title: Checked

guard_violations.description: Short ids (`PackSlot.id`) of the guard lines the turn went against: a value of the guarded kind other than the guarded one.
guard_violations.title: Guard Violations

unbacked_values.description: The values with no source, in the order said.
unbacked_values.title: Unbacked Values

Backing.title: Backing

masked.description: Values held back from the accepted items before storage, by type (`card`, `cvv`, `password`, `secret`): the stored text says `[retido:cartão ****1234]` where the value was.
masked.title: Masked

BiFile.description:
The company's BI export for the period, uploaded first (`POST /v1/measure/reconcile/uploads`), as CSV
with a header: `order` (the id the company knows the object by), `line` (optional), `value` (in major
units, as the signed definition nets it) and `currency`. It is read once and deleted.
BiFile.title: BiFile

upload_headers.description: Send exactly these headers; the storage refuses other bytes.
upload_headers.title: Upload Headers

BiUploadRequest.description: Reserves the upload of the company's BI file: its size and SHA-256, which the storage checks.
BiUploadRequest.title: BiUploadRequest

BoundArg.description:
One argument of the tool and the field it carries. `in` and `eq` render to `param`, `not_in` and `ne`
to the negation's, and a comparison or `between` only when `ops` lists it.

transform.description: The case text is sent in.
transform.title: Transform

BoundArg.title: BoundArg

BudgetBlock.description:
The context budget of one read: what the pack costs, what this agent already spent in the conversation
and the case, and what can go without loss. It is shown, never enforced: the agent's loop decides.

case.description: This agent's turns in the case (`task_id`).

conversation.description: This agent's turns in the conversation; absent without one.

counted.description: False when the counters could not be read: the numbers above are then missing, not zero.
counted.title: Counted

cut.description: Absent until the measurement found a unit.

other_agents_turns.description: Turns other agents recorded in the same conversation.
other_agents_turns.title: Other Agents Turns

pack.description: Absent when the read served no pack.

BudgetBlock.title: BudgetBlock

BudgetCut.description:
What the measurement of context use says this agent leaves unused, by unit of items: delivered in
enough measured conversations and never used.

applied.description: The pack already leaves them out.
applied.title: Applied

BudgetCut.title: BudgetCut

cap_micros.description: The daily ceiling, in millionths of a US dollar.
cap_micros.title: Cap Micros

day.description: The UTC day the spend counts in.

from_contract.description: True when the contract sets it; false for the cell's default.
from_contract.title: From Contract

reached.description: Work of this purpose waits for the next UTC day.
reached.title: Reached

BudgetPack.description: What the pack of this read costs, in estimated tokens, whole and per section.
BudgetPack.title: BudgetPack

BudgetUse.description: What this agent's recorded turns added up to, in one conversation or one case.

model_calls.description: Each one reads the prompt's prefix again.
model_calls.title: Model Calls

BudgetUse.title: BudgetUse

breakpoints.description: Character offsets where a cache breakpoint may be placed.
breakpoints.title: Breakpoints

salt.description: Stable cache salt for self-hosted engines.
salt.title: Salt

anchor_copy_matches.description: Whether the copy of the root kept outside the database holds the recomputed root; false when it is missing or differs, null while the day is not anchored or the copy cannot be read.
anchor_copy_matches.title: Anchor Copy Matches

anchor_locked.description: Whether that copy sits in write-once storage (Object Lock in compliance mode) that nobody, the cell included, can delete or replace before its retention ends.
anchor_locked.title: Anchor Locked

anchored_root.description: Hex Merkle root written by the daily anchor.
anchored_root.title: Anchored Root

root_matches.description: None while the day is not anchored yet.
root_matches.title: Root Matches

Change.description:
One entry of the change log a bisection walks: a pin that changed between two builds of an agent, or
a section of the space's configuration that changed between two applied snapshots (`config`, named by
the section, with no agent: every agent reads it, and its digests stand for the values).

name.description: The prompt or the tool, for those kinds.
name.title: Name

Change.title: Change

ChangeSinceSeen.description: A field of an interest whose value is not the one the subject was shown.

observed_at.description: When the source observed the value now held.
observed_at.title: Observed At

ChangeSinceSeen.title: ChangeSinceSeen

CheckRequest.description:
What an agent is about to do. Without a subject there is no budget, suppression or owner to consult:
such a check only asks about the effect key.

destination_hash.description: The token's `rcpt`, computed by a caller that holds the gateway's key, when the destination is not the subject's handle.
destination_hash.title: Destination Hash

effect_key.description: The business fact's key; reserved atomically when nothing holds it.
effect_key.title: Effect Key

CheckRequest.title: CheckRequest

off to with `handoff_to`. `contact_token` comes only with an allowed outbound contact of a purpose that

contact_window_until.description: With `contact_window`: when the subject's contact window on the channel ends, the first moment the contact may go.

ClaimContractSummary.description:
The contract as the SDK keeps it: everything but the negative corpus's phrases, which only the CI's
`niadra contract test` reads, from the company's own copy.
ClaimContractSummary.title: ClaimContractSummary

ClaimEvidence.description: What the turn record must hold for a claim of the category to stand: exactly one kind.

tool.description: A call of this tool in the turn.

ClaimEvidence.title: ClaimEvidence

ClaimEvidenceRef.description: Where a claim's evidence is in the turn record: a call's field, an object's field, or a document.

anchor.description: The blob that keeps the quoted text.

ClaimRecord.description: One claim the SDK found in an output, as the turn record carries it: kinds, spans and verdicts.

span.description: Code point offsets of the claim in the output, end exclusive.

ClaimRequest.description:
A declared claim, held by `holder`. `level` defaults to the space's least restrictive level; a
declaration is refused (409 `lease_held`) while another holder's claim is at least as restrictive, and the
same holder renews its own. `lease_s` is capped by the space's longest declared lease. A task lock names
an object and its `task`, and is refused (409 `task_locked`) while another holder has that task.

observed_at.description: When the source saw it; an observation older than the source's last is ignored.
observed_at.title: Observed At

source.description: An observation of this ownership source, read and sent by the company's worker: never refused, replacing what the source said before, and capped by the source's validity.
source.title: Source

ClaimRequest.title: ClaimRequest

A number the parser read, normalized: an amount, or a range from `min` to `max`, with its unit (the
currency code of money, `%`, a time unit, a unit of measure or of dose), or a date, or a range of
dates.
ClaimValue.title: ClaimValue

ClaimVia.description:
The three ways in: a declaration through the API, an observation mapped from a webhook, an observation
the company's worker read and sent.
ClaimVia.title: ClaimVia

ClosedBy.description: What closed an open item: the same object the `open_item.closed` webhook carried.

action_id.description: `action`: the agent action that closed it.

event_id.description: The event that closed it: the action's, the system of record's, or the feedback's.

Closes.description: The open item an action fulfils: by id, or by object and canonical operation.

CompanyRule.description:
A rule of the company delivered in the block, with where it lives and its rank in the order the company
declared: the block never ranks two origins by itself.

Conflict.description:
Two entries that cannot both hold, and the one that won: the current utterance over what was stated
before, and a stated entry over an inferred one. Between two company rules, it is also a data issue.
Conflict.title: Conflict

ConflictCounts.description: What coordination settled between parties in the window.

commitments_superseded.description: Commitments another of the subject's held first.
commitments_superseded.title: Commitments Superseded

handoffs_expired.description: Handoffs whose outcome did not come back in time.
handoffs_expired.title: Handoffs Expired

ownership_overlaps.description: Subjects and objects two holders claimed at the same time: the more restrictive held.
ownership_overlaps.title: Ownership Overlaps

tokens_reused.description: Contact tokens declared used more than once.
tokens_reused.title: Tokens Reused

never only sent, since a tool may relax a filter on its own.

relaxed_declared.title: Relaxed Declared

relaxed_suspected.description: Calls whose results suggest a relaxation the tool did not declare.
relaxed_suspected.title: Relaxed Suspected

unverifiable.description: Results that lacked a constrained field.
unverifiable.title: Unverifiable

verifiable.description: Results that held every constrained field.
verifiable.title: Verifiable

violated.description: Results that broke a hard constraint the tool did not say it relaxed.
violated.title: Violated

ConstraintRates.title: ConstraintRates

ConstraintsBlock.description: What one subject wants, refuses and is, for the tools of this turn (`constraints.v0`).

ask.description: Questions the agent should ask, as `for_whom`, before assuming.

contact_windows.description: The local hours the subject said they may not be contacted in, one per channel (null: every channel), the latest said: a contact of any purpose waits for the window's end.
contact_windows.title: Contact Windows

instructions.description: What people said must or must not be done about the objects the read is about.
instructions.title: Instructions

omitted.description: How many entries of each kind (`hard`, `soft`, `exclude`, `already_presented`, `instructions`) the block's sizes left out; the restrictions keep their room first. Absent when nothing was left out; `text` says it too.
omitted.title: Omitted

relaxation_order.description: What gives way first when a search finds nothing: `soft`, ids.
relaxation_order.title: Relaxation Order

text.description: The block as lines for a model, in the space's language, each field by its label and each operator in words; an empty string when the block has nothing to say. Not part of `version`.
text.title: Text

version.description: A digest of the block, which the turn record cites.
version.title: Version

at_limit.description: Of them, the ones with no contact left in the window.
at_limit.title: At Limit

subjects.description: Subjects with a contact still in the budget's window.
subjects.title: Subjects

ContactKey.description: An Ed25519 public key as a JWK (RFC 8037). A `retiring` key still verifies and signs nothing new.
ContactKey.title: ContactKey

ContactKeys.description: A space's public keys a gateway checks a contact token with, offline.

ContactMadeDetail.description:

purpose fails open and none came in time.

pointer.description: Where the SDK reads the text inside the company's boundary.

own metrics, refreshed at most once a minute.

available.description: False when the cell's metrics could not be read; the windows are empty.
available.title: Available

slo.description: The share of reads the objective expects under `target_ms`.
slo.title: Slo

target_ms.description: The published server time of a context read.
target_ms.title: Target Ms

ContextLatencyReport.title: ContextLatencyReport

degraded.description: Share of the reads served degraded: memory late, missing or a block left out.

error_budget_used.description: Share of the objective's error budget (the reads over `target_ms` it allows) spent; above 1 the objective was missed.

p50_ms.description: Median server time; null without reads.
p50_ms.title: P50 Ms

reads.description: Context reads of the space in the window.

under_target.description: Share of the reads the server answered in `target_ms` or less.

within_slo.description: Whether that share reached the objective, `slo` of the reads.

slots.description: The lines of `slots`, typed. Not part of the pinned sections.

about.description: The account or partner the person acts for.

format.description: `json` also returns `pack`: the same pack as typed sections, in the `context-pack.v1` shape, for programs that build their own prompt.

profile_id.description: The pseudonymous profile instead of a handle: the read of `GET /v1/context` with the conversation id in the body, never in the URL.

query.description: The customer's last turn. It selects the per-turn `slots` and never the pinned `text`, which is the same bytes with or without it. `brief` and `full` have no slots.
query.title: Query

about_unlinked.description: `about` named an account or partner with no active link to the subject: the pack is the subject's own, without that organization's block. It never says whether the organization exists.

constraints.description: With `include: ["constraints"]`: what the subject wants, refuses and is, for the tools of this turn (`constraints.v0`).

guards.description: What the guard lines among `slots` state, typed. An SDK checks the agent's answer against them and names a guard the answer went against on the agent's turn (`backing.guard_violations`).

live_complete.description: False when the hot layer was unavailable, a turn could not be read, or a handle had more recent turns than were read.

state.description: With `include: ["state"]`: the subject's objects of the declared types, each as a `display` read serves it (`object-state.v1`): values with their logical value, stamps, source and freshness computed now, and what may not be claimed with them.

withheld.description: Items and `live` turns the policy left out for this reader and level.

agent's turn, so measurement can tell a late context from an unused one.

ContextTrimOut.description: What one source's packs of one view leave out because it never used them.

active.description: False when the space turned trimming off or the source is exempt.
active.title: Active

derived_at.description: The measurement that last derived it.
derived_at.title: Derived At

answers_checked.description: Agent answers the SDK's backing check read (session-level rows, per agent source).

guard_violations.description: Guard lines the agents went against (each also counts in `contradicted`).
guard_violations.title: Guard Violations

instruction_violations.description: Agent messages that did what an instruction about an object the pack carried said not to do: a settlement proposed on a case whose instruction says not to propose one.

late_deliveries.description: Context delivered after the agent's first turn.
late_deliveries.title: Late Deliveries

no_context.description: Sessions without any `context()` read: coverage, never a zero rate.
no_context.title: No Context

object_rows.description: Rows about an object (what its participants said, its instructions, its open items) delivered on the object's line.

object_rows_used.description: Of those, the rows of objects the agent used.

selection_misses.description: Contradictions of items the pack did not carry; never the agent's.

tokens_saved.description: Tokens those packs left out, summed over deliveries: the compiler's estimate, the one its budgets use.
tokens_saved.title: Tokens Saved

trimmed_deliveries.description: Deliveries whose pack left out what that agent did not use.
trimmed_deliveries.title: Trimmed Deliveries

unbacked_per_1000.description: `unbacked_values` per thousand checked answers; null without any.
unbacked_per_1000.title: Unbacked Per 1000

unbacked_values.description: Numbers, dates, codes and amounts those answers stated that no source the agent had backs: the pack, the system records, the customer's words, the tool results it recorded.

vendor.description: From the source configuration; "" when a source has none.
vendor.title: Vendor

view.description: Empty for session-level counters (coverage, transfers, recontacts).
view.title: View

tokens_saved.description: Tokens this delivery's pack left out for lack of use.
tokens_saved.title: Tokens Saved

claims.description: With the `claims` agent feature on: per source and agent, the claims of its outputs by category and verdict, from the turn records.

constraints.description: With the `signals` agent feature on: per source and agent, the hard constraints its tools were sent, could verify and violated, and the items its lists showed.

cost.description: With the `turns` agent feature on: per source and agent, calls, tokens and money per turn, against the cost with memory off the company measured.

force.description: Overrides the verified-profiles and organization protections.

table.description: `product`: the product's table of public prices; `space`: the space's settings.

What someone said must or must not be done about an object the read is about: a task on the object,

hard.description: The entry of `hard` that carries it for a tool, when `attr` is set.

text.description: As it was said, short: what a reader honors without a tool binding.

ObjectInstruction.title: ObjectInstruction

first, at most 20 of each kind, as this reader may read it.

instructions.description: What must or must not be done about the object.
instructions.title: Instructions

items.description: Promises, disputes and requests about the object still open.
items.title: Items

ObjectMemoryOut.title: ObjectMemoryOut

inputs.title: Inputs

request_id.description: The refresh request this item answers, from the resolver worker's lease: the request is settled, and a `watch_revalidation` is decided on these values even when they are not newer than the ones held.
request_id.title: Request Id

version.description: The source's version of the object. A field moves only when this is greater than the version that last wrote it; a source never reuses a version for other content.
version.title: Version

ObjectPushResponse.description:
How many items of the request each decision took, against the hot layer, with no database statement.

A shared object's item is `applied` when at least one of its fields moved forward: reads serve it at once,
and the consolidator writes it within a second with the same per-field rule, so the stored object never
disagrees with the answer. `stale_version`: every field was already written by this version or a greater
one, as a retried request finds. `out_of_set`: the object is not in the working set, and nothing is kept.
A subject's object is `recorded`: accepted as a system event about it, in the request's one statement,
and its fields move by the same rule when the event is applied.
ObjectPushResponse.title: ObjectPushResponse

ObjectRead.description:
One object as a state read serves it: fields with four logical values and their stamps, computed
values, lifecycle, timers and readings, and what may not be claimed with data this old. A read never
refuses; a `decide` read of a type that asks for it carries `refusal` beside the values, for the company's
tool.

axes.description: Each time axis of the type whose value is known: a date as `YYYY-MM-DD`, an instant in UTC. The platform keeps `known_at` (when the producer first knew of the object) and the time its content last changed.
axes.title: Axes

blocked.description: What the fields whose value is not known block, as the type declares it (`unobserved_blocks`): each activity (`model_read`, `derive`, `claim`, or a task of the company such as `decide:close`) with the fields that block it. Nothing else is blocked.

derived.description: The type's derived fields, from the related objects.
derived.title: Derived

expired_by.description: The inputs whose change expired it.
expired_by.title: Expired By

memory.description: What its owner and participants said about it, in a context read that serves a pack.

withheld.description: Fields left out for this reader, and why.
withheld.title: Withheld

ObjectRef.description: A business object in a system of record, e.g. `invoice` / `erp` / `0823`.

promise.description: An open item the company owns: a promise made to the customer.

versions.description: Earlier and current versions, oldest first, when the item has them.

exposure token the order line or the order carried, or the agent's own action on the object.
`identity` and `assisted_handoff` are probable: the same item engaged with or shown within a window, or a
handoff that assisted the sale. A link carries its line's value whole or none at all: a value is never
weighted.

final_at.description: When a provisional link becomes final.

finality.description: `provisional` until the exchange window ends or the object reaches a final state; `expired_without_outcome` when its deadline passed first.

purchase.description: The purchase it counts in, when the revenue definition counts a split purchase's parts as one order.
